text: Orluga Slacks are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are dropped by Orlugas in Eryth Sea and can be traded for in Alcamoth and Eryth Sea. According to their description, they are dirty slacks that are mentioned in the Nopon song "Orluga's Lovely Trousers". Three of them are needed for Material Quest 3 in Alcamoth.
The Orthlus' Liver is a Key Item in . It must be acquired for Preparing for Adventure 3, and is obtained by defeating the Lakebed Orthlus at Agora Shore outside Colony 9.

Operation Rainfall was a fan campaign launched on June 23, 2011 that worked to promote Japanese games that are obscure in the West or have not been released. Its original goal, and most famous endeavor, was the localization and release of the games The Last Story, Pandora's Tower, and Xenoblade Chronicles. This campaign could be considered the reason that Xenoblade Chronicles has been released in North America.

Opening the Bulkhead (Japanese: , Daikakuheki wo Kaihōseyo) is a Story Quest in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is received automatically once the party reaches the 3rd Lift - 3F while progressing through Mechonis Field.
Ordinary Hides are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles.
Patella Exhaust (Japanese: , Kishin Hiza-bu Haikikō) is a location in . It is located on the fourth floor of Mechonis Field, and is accessed right before the Upper Bulkhead Bridge.
The Orb Storage Level (Japanese: , Kafundama Sōko-ban) is a location in . It is located on the second floor of Frontier Village. The Pollen Orb Storehouse is on this level.
Ornate Lizard Claws are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are dropped by Leg Lizards and can be traded for with Kiroki.

Overlooking the Colony (Japanese: , Koronī no Mieru Kishi de, On the Shore viewing the Colony) is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located on Agora Shore in Colony 9, between Reyn and Sharla at purple affinity. It can only be viewed after the events in the Ether Mine.
Overcoming the Pain (Japanese: , Itami wo Norikoete) is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located on Digit 1 of the Fallen Arm, between Fiora and Melia at pink affinity.

Partisan Eagle (known as Long Lancer in the Japanese version) is a Class featured in . This class provides bonuses to ranged attack and accuracy. Their weapons are the Sniper Rifle and Javelin. It is one of two classes that can be leveled up from Commando and can be leveled up to Astral Crusader. The playable characters of this class include Lao and Bozé. Alexa and Liesel's class is an Alternative Partisan Eagle, called Partisan Eagle+.

Outfitters is a division within BLADE in , which supports the development of the Arms Manufacturers, developer of weapons for both Skells and infantry. This division is known as Arms (Japanese: , Āmuzu) in the Japanese version. Outfitters receive increased Division Points from gathering R&D points and leveling up Arms Manufacturers. Receiving division support from Outfitters grants R&D Support, which increases number of R&D points gained during combat.

Orphean Technologies (Japanese: , Orufe Parufe, Orphe Parfait) is a product Arms Manufacturer in Xenoblade Chronicles X. Formed by Orpheans who fled the Ganglion, the arms manufacturer produces gear very different to that of human make. This AM is unlocked upon completion of the Rescue at the Ensconced Citadel Normal Mission. They mainly build products with high evasion, but their best seller is a line of gravity-attribute weapons. Their Skell Weapons consist of weapon modules looted from enemy Qmoevas, Galdrs, and Seidrs.
Ovis (Japanese: , Owisu) are small sheep-like herbivore enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X dwelling in prairies. They are similar to Kapibas in Xenoblade Chronicles 2.
Overclock is one of Alexa's two Signature Arts in . It is an Aura art. Cross can learn it by completing the Affinity Mission What the Skell?!.

The Origin Blatta (Japanese: , Orijin Buratta) is a Main Boss in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is the first enemy encountered in the game, fought at level 1 at the Starfall Basin in Primordia during the prologue. It is a member of the Blatta family, and is a bigger form of the Pebble Blatta.
Pawn Pugiliths (Japanese: , Pōn Berudero) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Pugilith machines, Ganglion's vehicles, and can be found at level 10 guarding the Seaswept Base in Primordia.
Pawn Puges (Japanese: , Pōn Berude) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Puge machines, Ganglion's human size robots, and can be found at level 9 guarding the Seaswept Base in Primordia.

The Orpheans (English dub: ) or Orphe (Japanese: , Orufe; English dub: ) are a race of beings in . They are an alien race who were exiled from the Ganglion. They are a highly intelligent and discrete tribe of technology builders, and they were the makers of many of the Skell weapons for the Ganglion. They founded the Orphean Technologies Arms Manufacturer. The party first encounters an Orphean, Kun'luarb, in Noctilum during the mission Rescue at the Ensconced Citadel. After the mission Circle of Life is completed, the Orpheans start to make their home in New Los Angeles. Oskar, the Summer Squall (Japanese: Ryokuu no Osukaru) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is an Aprica, and can be found at level 11 near Old Dragontail Tree, in Noctilum during the day. Defeating it is required to complete the eponymous Basic Mission Oskar, the Summer Squall.
Partners in Pearls is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from the Curators and the primary destination is Primordia.
Panyar is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She is a Ma-non and can be found in the Commercial District of New Los Angeles, near Central Melville Street.
Overwhelm is a Debuff Battle Art in . It inflicts Fatigue and deals more damage if the user's health is high.
Origin Mortifoles (Japanese: , Orijin Foriumu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Mortifole family, and can be found at level 8-9 near FN Site 209 in Noctilum.

The Outfitters Test Hangar (Japanese: , Āmuzu Seinō Shikenjō) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in the Industrial District of New Los Angeles, south of the Integrated Production Plant. It is the test hangar of the Outfitters.
Pathogen Blast is a Debuff Art in . It inflicts Virus on the target.
Palace Knight Qmoevas (Japanese: , Kōtonaito Kumūba) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Ganglion Qmoevas and can be found at level 21-30 in Noctilum, south of FN Site 210.

Ornella (Japanese: , Orunera, English dub: ) is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She can be found at the Cathedral in the Residential District of New Los Angeles before completing Hope Springs Eternal. After completing Hope Springs Eternal, she can be found in Deliverance Park. She does not appear after completing A False Hope.
Pauline is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She can be found at West Melville Street in the Commercial District of New Los Angeles.
Otis (Japanese: , Obusu, English dub: ) is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found at the Hangar in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles.
Palace Queen Qmoevas (Japanese: , Kōtokuīn Kumūba) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Ganglion Qmoevas and can be found at level 41-50 in the Scabland Fortress in Oblivia.

Orochi's Belly (Japanese: , Orochi no Kobukuro) is an Unexplored Territory in . It is located in Noctilum, south of Coil Tree Cape and below the Elephant's Trunk. There is a mechanical Treasure Box here, and several Caecuses. As with all Unexplored Territories, its discovery yields an achievement ("Searching Orochi's Belly"). Orochi's Belly must be discovered to complete Off the Record (archaeological) in the .
Pardo Spiders (Japanese: , Parudosupaidā) are rare collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Noctilum.

Ouroboros Bracelets (Japanese: , Marumaru Buresuretto) are prime collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Oblivia, in particular near FN Site 322. Six of them are needed for The Endless Ring.

Pale Maize (Japanese: , Hākōn) is a prime collectible in . They can be found in Sylvalum, in particular at Delusians South Summit. Eight lots are needed for the level 5 Biological Basic Mission Off the Record in the original version and four lots are needed for the Mechanical Basic Mission Off the Record in the .

Pan-Analysis Chips (Japanese: , Tōtaruanaraizā) are common collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Cauldros, around FN Site 503 at the White Phosphor Lake. Six of them are needed for Alexa's Affinity Mission What the Skell?!.
Oxygen Airbrakes (Japanese: , Okishijen Seidō Sōchi) are common collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Cauldros.

Orion Xerns (Japanese: , Oraion Zerun) are enemies in and . They are Xern machines, and four can be found at level 75 in various places in the skies of Cauldros: Titan's Table, FN Site 505, south of FN Site 510, Kitsune Stronghold, and during the assault on the Lifehold Core.

Pastoral Cervuses (Japanese: , Purīsuto Keruusu, Priest Cervus) are minor enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Cervus family, and can be found at level 60 at the Nopon Highroad or Divine Roost in Noctilum during the day.
Ovis Polishing Stones are common materials in . They can be obtained from Ovis in Primordia.

Origin Cantors (Japanese: , Orijin Imupureka) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Cantor family, and can be found at level 58-60 at Demon's Pocket in Oblivia. While some of them are posed as statues, they are not hidden and can be targeted before battle.

Parasite Gerrids (Japanese: , Parasaito Girafa) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Gerrid family, and can be found at level 51-70, specifically level 60, in Oblivia's North Coast while fighting Gradivus, the Headless Emperor.
Ouroboros Crystals are Precious Resources in Xenoblade Chronicles X. Gathering four of them is needed for the Normal Mission Good Neighbors.
Parhelion Platinum is a Precious Resource in Xenoblade Chronicles X.
Ornate Progen Horns are rare materials in . They can be dropped by Progen. Two are needed for the Basic Mission From Idea to Inventory.
Pack It In (Japanese: , Puraido, Pride) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Nococche in the Central Industrial District of New Los Angeles.

Palace King Qmoevas (Japanese: , Kōtokingu Kumūba) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Qmoeva machines, and can be found at level 57 on a rock projection north of Anvil Rock One in Sylvalum. They are dormant until approached.
Overdrive: Recover HP is an armor Augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X which recovers the user's HP when overdrive is activated. The Skell equivalent is Overdrive.FRAME-HP.
Palace Barrager Zigs (Japanese: , Kōtobaretto Jigu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Zig machines, and can be found at level 31-40 in Cauldros, west of FN Site 508.
Paqu Qadossi is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She is a Tree Clan Prone and can be found at the Armory Alley in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles, just outside L's Shop.

Ovah and Out (Japanese: , Ōva no Shōtai, The Ovah's Truth) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Han'barac outside the Mimeosome Maintenance Center in the Administrative District.

The Ozuchi Caladar (Japanese: , Zo Ozuchi) is a Mission Exclusive Secondary Boss in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Caladar Skell piloted by Zo Ozuchi. It is fought at level 90 in the Outfitters Test Hangar in the Industrial District during the final battle of The Gauntlet.

Pastimes and Pride is a Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located at a raised parking structure near Central Melville Street in the Commercial District of New Los Angeles between Doug and Cross at any time.

Peacekeeping is a Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located behind the shipping crates near East Melville Street in the Commercial District of New Los Angeles between Yelv and Cross at late night.

Orleron (Japanese: , Ōreron) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is a Zaruboggan and can be found in the Central Industrial District. He will move to the Deck of the Ma-non Ship if the B Route is chosen during Child of Mira. He is the offspring of Arsenican. Although Zaruboggans are listed as gender unknown in the Affinity Chart, Orleron is addressed as "he" by Arsenican.
Ornate Petramand Claws are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Praseodymium Petramands in Cauldros.
Orphean Pluck (Japanese: , Orufe no Iji, Orphean Will) is a Normal Mission in . It can be received from San'luarb in the Industrial District of New Los Angeles, near the Integrated Production Plant.

Passions is Lin's fifth Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It occurs between Lin and Cross in the morning, atop a shipping container west of Deliverance Park in the Residential District of New Los Angeles.
Papil Punisher is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from the Interceptors and the primary destination is Primordia.
Partners in Prototyping is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from Candid & Credible and the primary destination is Oblivia.
Papil Straws are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Papils.
Park Patrol is Celica's second Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It takes place in the morning, north of the Residential District's Sports Complex.
Ovah Overdrive is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from an Orphean for Garudo Pellionia Minima in Primordia.

Partner Wanted! is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from Muimui and the primary destination is the Commercial District in New Los Angeles. It leads into The Sword of Legendaryness, though accepting it is not a prerequisite.
Party Procurement is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from a female resident of NLA, and the primary destination is Cauldros.
Parenting is a Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located anytime at the Sports Complex in the Residential District of New Los Angeles between Mia and Cross.

Orton (Japanese: , Ōruto, English dub: ) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is a Human and is encountered at Sylvalum's Badr Stronghold during Reporting for Duty. After this mission, he can be found at the Mimeosome Maintenance Center in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles at night.
Ornate Insidia Claws are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from red Insidias. They are a component in I and V Arts: Gain TP and Arts.GP augments.

Parasitic Capsules are common materials in . They can be obtained from Milsaadi, for 34 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks, or for 15 Material Tickets from the Material Market in . They are components in X, XV, and XX Opening Art: Damage Up and Draw.OPENING-DMG augments.

Orange Tequila are common materials in . They can be obtained from Tectinsulas decorated with jungle foliage, for 54 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks, or for 20 Material Tickets from the Material Market in . They are components of Potential Drive I and V augments.

Orichalcum Metal are unique materials in They can be obtained from Sharnaak's Seidr, for 138 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks, or for 90 Material Tickets from the Material Market in . They are components in Overdrive Surge XV and XX augments.
Ovis A is a Holofigure in . It depicts a beige ovis variant. It can be obtained from Baabara, the Evangelical in Primordia, Heidi, the Lively or Claire, the Sheltered in Noctilum.
Ovis B is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a white ovis variant. It can be obtained from Clara, the Pure White in Sylvalum.
Ovis C is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a brown ovis variant. It can be obtained from Germaine, the Treasure Keeper in Oblivia.
Papil A is a Holofigure in . It depicts a purple papil variant. It can be obtained from Caranau, the Water Drake in Primordia.
Papil B is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a green papil variant. It can be obtained from Sacrum, the Noctilucent in Noctilum.

Patrol Route Shutdown is a Squad Mission in . It is part of BLADE Mission No.3, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of collecting five Fauna. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Overseas Celery is a Squad Mission in . It is part of BLADE Mission No.6, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of collecting six Mizaria Celeries. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Outcast is a Squad Mission in . It is part of BLADE Mission No.11, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of hunting sixteen Ciniculas. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Parasites is a Squad Mission in . It is part of BLADE Mission No.17, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of hunting fourteen Visigels. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Panicked Dancers is a Squad Mission in . It is part of BLADE Mission No.18, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of hunting twenty Arenatects. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.
Overdrive Surge is an armor Augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X that increases the chance of triggering the Activate Overdrive Soul Voice.
Overdrive Count Up is a ground weapon Overdrive Augment in and that increases the Overdrive counter upon starting Overdrive.
Overdrive Blue Bonus is a ground weapon Overdrive Augment in and that adds 10 to the Overdrive counter when using a blue Battle Art during Overdrive.
Overdrive Green Bonus is a ground weapon Overdrive Augment in and that adds 3 to the Overdrive counter when using a green Battle Art during Overdrive.
The Parched Terebra is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Terebra and can be found at level 30 or 31 in the Sunlit Spring in Noctilum during No-show Nen'celeg.
Overdrive: Gain TP is an armor Augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X that gives a boost to TP when activating Overdrive.
Overdrive.FRAME-HP is a Skell frame Overdrive augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It recovers 1% to 20% of HP when activating Overdrive. The ground equivalent is Overdrive: Recover HP.
Overdrive.APPEND-HP is a Skell frame Overdrive augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It recovers 1% to 20% of HP to all appendages when activating Overdrive.
Overdrive.EXTEND is a Skell frame Overdrive augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It increases Overdrive sustainment rate by 1% to 20%.
The Party Suit is Casual Wear full body armor in and . It is produced by Sakuraba Industries. Only one can be obtained per playthrough.

The Party Gauge is a battle mechanic in and . Like in , it is a three-bar gauge displayed on the top left corner of the screen. A full bar is necessary to revive an incapacitated member. The full gauge is necessary to initiate a Chain Attack. The Party Gauge is a white three-bar gauge that is filled as the party characters fight together. The energy gathered in a full bar is necessary to revive an incapacitated member and the full gauge is necessary to initiate a Chain Attack, where each Driver attacks in succession with their Blades' Specials.
